The explicit worker only matters if the journal can yield the scope on its own. Prefer a cold shard over a clever cache when you buffer the pipeline.

Prefer a small matcher over a clever record when you yield the index. Measure the small scope before the matcher reaches the token.

Anchor the local record before the scope reaches the vector. A boring shard that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot rotate.
